    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    You can use Google Translate to translate text, speech, images, and websites across hundreds of languages. 
    Key Features
    • Text Translation: Type or paste text to translate between supported languages.
    • Instant Camera & Photos: Point your camera at signs or import images to translate text in real time.
    • Voice & Conversations: Use dictation for spoken words or translate bilingual conversations on the fly.
    • Offline Mode: Download language packs to translate text without an internet connection.
    • Web & Browser Integration:
      Access the tool directly via the Google Translate Website or install the Google Translate Chrome Extension to read web pages in your preferred language.
       
    If you need help translating a specific phrase, document, or language pair, paste it here and I can help.
